surveillance_motion.label: Motion detected (old)
surveillance_motion.note: Old combined category, kept only for compatibility. Better use the three levels Notice, Alert and Critical below.

surveillance_motion_notice.label: Guardian – Notice
surveillance_motion_notice.note: Normal movement or someone walking past. Off by default – turn it on if you want to hear about every event.

surveillance_motion_alert.label: Guardian – Alert
surveillance_motion_alert.note: A person is close to the car, a vehicle is approaching, or something is happening right at the car.

surveillance_motion_critical.label: Guardian – Critical
surveillance_motion_critical.note: A person is very close or stays at the car. Check right away.

surveillance_proximity.label: Proximity
surveillance_proximity.note: Distance and trigger depend on the recording settings.

surveillance_ai_off.label: AI detection off
surveillance_ai_off.note: The AI model is not running; until it is back, the Guardian records on any motion.

camping_hinweis.label: Camping: notices
camping_hinweis.note: Camping on/off, a door or window opened while camping (guardian occupied, no alarm).

camping_warnung.label: Camping: warnings
camping_warnung.note: Camping: battery close to or at the lower limit, weak 12 V battery, maximum time reached.

surveillance_guard_stop.label: Guardian paused / back on
surveillance_guard_stop.note: The Guardian pauses to save the battery (low charge, weak 12 V battery, parked too long, quiet times or quiet zones).

vehicle_health_tyre_pressure.label: Tyre pressure warning
vehicle_health_tyre_pressure.note: The tyre pressure sensor reports too little or too much pressure.

vehicle_health_tyre_leak.label: Tyre losing air
vehicle_health_tyre_leak.note: The tyre pressure sensor reports a slow or fast loss of pressure.

vehicle_security_door_opened.label: Door opened
vehicle_security_door_opened.note: When a door, the bonnet or the boot is opened while the car is parked (switched off).

vehicle_security_door_closed.label: Door closed
vehicle_security_door_closed.note: When a door, the bonnet or the boot is closed while the car is parked (switched off).

vehicle_charging_started.label: Charging started
vehicle_charging_started.note: When the battery management reports that charging has begun.

vehicle_charging_stopped.label: Charging stopped
vehicle_charging_stopped.note: With a 10 s delay so short gaps while plugging in or at a fast charger do not count.

vehicle_charging_full.label: Charging complete
vehicle_charging_full.note: Once per charge, when the battery is nearly full or the battery management reports charging as finished. Not when you plug in a car that is already full. Also comes during quiet hours so you remember to unplug.

vehicle_charging_fault.label: Charging fault
vehicle_charging_fault.note: The battery management reports a fault at the AC or DC charger, the charging plug or the on-board charger.

vehicle_health_soh_frame_mismatch.label: Battery capacity does not match
vehicle_health_soh_frame_mismatch.note: Once, when the capacity reported by the battery management differs by more than 15% from the one entered – usually nominal instead of usable capacity on a plug-in hybrid. The battery dialog fixes it with one tap.

automation_action.label: Rule triggered
automation_action.note: Comes when a rule contains the action “Send notification”.

genai_insight.label: AI note ready
genai_insight.note: Only when notifications for AI notes are explicitly turned on.

parking_session_started.label: Parked – where and what is around
parking_session_started.note: About 90 s after switching off: place, how fresh the GPS is, whether the Guardian is on, and a still from all four cameras. Needs the parking analysis in the Guardian settings.

parking_session_ended.label: Back at the car – what happened
parking_session_ended.note: At the first unlock or door opening: how long you were away, how many Guardian events there were and how many vehicles came or left next to you.

network_hotspot_limit.label: Hotspot data limit reached
network_hotspot_limit.note: When the hotspot goes over its set data limit; it is turned off at the same time. Raise or reset the limit to use it again.

gewohnheit_probe.label: Habits: trial run
gewohnheit_probe.note: A learned rule in trial run only reports what it would have done – it does not switch anything yet.

vehicle_control.cloud_gate_car_on: The car is on – please operate it in the car. Via the BYD cloud this only works while the car is off.
vehicle_control.cloud_gate_state_unknown: Car state unknown – cloud command blocked.
vehicle_control.cloud_gate_state_stale: Car state is out of date – cloud command blocked.
vehicle_control.cloud_required: Link a BYD account under System to use this
vehicle_control.cloud_unavailable_used_local: Cloud not reachable — sent directly instead
vehicle_control.cloud_offline_used_local: Cloud is offline — sent directly instead
vehicle_control.local_unavailable_used_cloud: Direct link not available — sent through the cloud instead
vehicle_control.cloud_failed: The car didn't answer — try again once it's awake
vehicle_control.local_failed: The car turned the command down over the direct link
vehicle_control.both_legs_failed: The command got through neither directly nor through the cloud
vehicle_control.rate_limited: Another command is still running — wait a few seconds
vehicle_control.car_off_climate_needs_cloud: The car is off – pre-heating can’t work directly then. Set up the BYD cloud (System → BYD account), then it also works with the car switched off.
vehicle_control.car_off_needs_cloud: The car is off – this can’t work directly then. Set up the BYD cloud (System → BYD account), then it also works with the car switched off.

automation.find_car_description: Blinks the lights and honks so you can spot the car.
automation.windows_all_description: Opens, closes or stops all windows.
automation.vent_windows_description: Opens all windows a crack, the way BYD's remote venting does.
automation.tailgate_description: Opens, closes or stops the rear hatch.
automation.save_seat_position: Store in the car's seat memory
automation.save_seat_position_description: Saves the driver's seat position in one of the car's own memory slots. This is separate from the positions saved in Panoptes, and the mirrors are not saved.
automation.child_lock_description: Turns the child safety lock on the rear doors on or off.
automation.wireless_charging_description: Turns the wireless phone charging pad on or off.
automation.set_slw_description: Sets the speed limit warning. Doesn't work while the car is switched off.
automation.set_esp_description: Sets the stability control (ESP). Careful: with ESP off, the car no longer helps you stay stable. Doesn't work while the car is switched off, and the car may turn ESP back on at the next start.
automation.set_itac_description: Sets the iTAC traction control (Intelligent Torque Adaption Control). Doesn't work while the car is switched off.
automation.set_mirror_fold_description: Folds the outside mirrors in or out. Doesn't work while the car is switched off.
automation.set_mirror_auto_follow_up_description: Turns on the car's own mirror setting. The car then folds the mirrors in and out whenever it is switched off or on. Turn this on while the car is switched on.
automation.set_cpd_description: Sets the child presence detection. Doesn't work while the car is switched off.
automation.set_sunshade_description: Controls the roof blind. Stop halts it where it is. Doesn't work while the car is switched off.
automation.set_sunroof_description: Controls the sunroof. Stop halts it where it is. Doesn't work while the car is switched off. Take care in a rule: it will open even if it's raining.
automation.set_drl_description: Sets the daytime running lights. Doesn't work while the car is switched off.
automation.set_headlight_mode_description: Sets the car's own light switch. Off only works when the car is safely parked. This talks to the car directly and doesn't work while it is switched off.
automation.set_hazard_description: Turns the hazard lights on or off. Not every model allows this. If the car ignores it, nothing happens.
automation.media_control_description: Controls what is playing right now (play/pause, next, back), whether it's radio, Bluetooth or an app.
automation.volume_step_description: Turns the volume of one channel up or down by a single step.
automation.set_ambient_brightness_description: Sets how bright the interior mood light is (0-100%), at the front, back or both.
automation.set_ambient_power_description: Turns the interior mood light on or off, at the front, back or both. "Both" uses the main switch. One zone alone has no switch of its own: Off dims it to nothing and On brings back its earlier brightness. Doesn't work while the car is switched off.
automation.ambient_state_description: Fires when the interior mood light goes on or off, no matter how it was switched. Only for cars that report this.
automation.sun_phase_description: Tells whether it's day or night where the car is, based on GPS and local sunrise and sunset. Needs a GPS position.
automation.month_description: The month we're in right now.
automation.drive_mode_condition_description: The driving mode right now (Normal / ECO / Sport / Snow). Some models only report ECO and Sport.
automation.powertrain_mode_condition_description: Whether the car runs electric (EV) or hybrid (HEV). Only reported by hybrids that can run on fuel.
automation.lock_condition_description: Whether the car is locked or unlocked. Read from the car, with the cloud as a backup. Most reliable while parked.
automation.unlock_source_description: What was used to unlock the car last time.
automation.easy_entry_description: Whether the driver's seat is standing still, moving, or has finished moving for easy entry.
automation.energy_regen_condition_description: How strongly braking gives energy back to the battery: Standard, High or Max.
automation.send_notification_description: Sends a push alert to the installed apps that have alerts turned on. The text can contain ${var:NAME} or ${signal:TYPE}, which are swapped for the current value when the rule fires.
automation.actions_description: What happens when this rule fires. The steps run one after another and may start a little late.
automation.else_actions_description: What happens instead when the rule fires but its conditions are NOT met. Optional.
automation.power_description: Whether the car is switched off, in ACC or on. ACC means only the extras like radio are powered. This is the ignition stage, not how much power the motor uses. In MQTT it is sent as power_level, while the MQTT key called power is the motor output in kW.
automation.gear_description: The gear that is selected right now.
automation.triggers_description: What the rule keeps an eye on. Whenever one of these values changes, the rule checks its conditions. Tip: add every signal you are waiting for. To react to a right turn at low speed, add both the right indicator and the speed, then set the exact values in the conditions below.
automation.conditions_description: What must be true when the rule fires. If the conditions no longer fit when the steps are about to start, the rule is dropped. The conditions don't have to match the triggers.
automation.delay_description: How many seconds to wait before the steps start. If the conditions change during the wait, the steps are not carried out.
automation.window_open_percent: How far the window is open (%)
automation.window_open_percent_description: How far the windows are open. 0 is shut, 100 is fully open.
automation.window_state_description: Whether the windows are open or closed. It reads closed when they are shut, otherwise open. For the choice All, it reads open as soon as any one window is open.
automation.battery_level_description: How full the EV battery is, in percent. The fuel tank of a hybrid is not counted.
automation.target_soc_description: The charge target that is set in the car right now, in percent.
automation.set_target_soc_description: Sets the charge level a plug-in hybrid (PHEV) tries to keep while driving, from 15 to 70 %. DM2.5 cars never go below 25 %. This only saves the value. It does not switch on Battery hold.
automation.estimated_range_description: The range the car estimates, in km. Electric range only. The extra range from fuel in a hybrid is not included.
automation.lights_description: Which lights are on right now.
automation.slw_description: Whether the speed warning is switched on or off.
automation.cpd_description: Whether the child-in-car detection is switched on or off.
automation.seat_climate_description: The seat heating and cooling settings right now.
automation.steering_heat_description: Shows whether the steering wheel heating is on. Not available if the car does not report it.
automation.ac_description: Whether the climate control is on or off. The car has to be switched on for it to run.
automation.temperature_description: The measured temperature inside the car in °C – only with a real cabin sensor. Many BYD have none (e.g. Dolphin Surf: the climate module's value is the dial setpoint). Then the condition is never met. Outside temperature and the climate setpoint are separate values.
automation.outside_temperature_description: The temperature outside in °C. It comes from the outside sensor, or from local weather if there is none. It never uses the inside sensor.
automation.ac_setpoint_description: What the climate control is SET to (the dial), not what it really is inside. Value 17–33: on the Dolphin Surf this is the bar on the display, 17 = strongest cooling, 25 = middle (neutral), 26–33 = heating level 1–8. Not available if the car does not report it.
automation.set_ac_description: Turns the climate control on or off. Does not work while the car is switched off. With “Turn off after” it stops by itself after the time you pick. That way it can't drain the battery if you forget, for example when warming up or airing out the car. “No countdown” sets no timer here. To stop a timer that is already running, use the “AC off timer” action.
automation.remote_climate_schedule_description: Plans a climate start through the cloud for a time in the future, given in epoch seconds.
automation.remote_climate_schedule_update_descripti: Changes a planned cloud climate start. You need the exact booking ID.
automation.remote_climate_schedule_delete_descripti: Deletes a planned cloud climate start. You need the exact booking ID.
automation.set_ac_auto_off_description: Turns the climate control off by itself after a set time, without changing it now. Pick “No countdown” to stop a timer that is already running. Running this action again restarts the timer instead of adding a second one. Switching the climate off by hand also stops it. The timer survives a restart, so the climate still goes off after the car is parked.
automation.set_ac_temp_description: Sets the climate level (17–33, 25 = neutral, from 26 it heats). Does not work while the car is switched off.
automation.step_ac_temp_description: Makes the climate one level warmer or cooler than it is now, instead of setting a fixed value. Stops at the lowest and highest level. Does not work while the car is switched off.
automation.set_ac_fan_description: Sets how fast the climate fan blows. Does not work while the car is switched off.
automation.set_ac_auto_description: Switches the automatic mode of the climate control on or off. Does not work while the car is switched off.
automation.set_ac_sync_description: Links or unlinks the passenger temperature with the driver's. Does not work while the car is switched off.
automation.set_fan_only_description: Turns ventilation without the compressor on or off. Does not work while the car is switched off.
automation.set_steering_heat_description: Turns the heated steering wheel on or off. Does not work while the car is switched off.
automation.set_front_defrost_description: Turns the defrost for the front windscreen on or off. Does not work while the car is switched off.
automation.set_rear_defrost_description: Turns the defrost for the rear windscreen on or off. Does not work while the car is switched off.
automation.set_recirculation_description: Switches between air from inside the car (recirculation) and fresh air from outside.
automation.set_welcome_light_description: Turns the greeting light on or off. It lights up when you walk up to the car.
automation.set_reading_light_description: Turns the interior light (reading light) on or off.
automation.set_ambient_music_description: Turns the mode on or off where the ambient lights pulse with the music.
automation.set_headlight_level_description: Sets the height of the headlight beam, from 1 to 11.
automation.set_seat_position_description: Recalls one of the car's own seat memory slots. This is not the same as the positions saved in Panoptes, and it does not move the mirrors. On some models these slots can't be set from the car's screen, so they may still hold factory settings. Does not work while the car is switched off.
automation.open_windows_description: Opens the windows by the percentage you choose. It can be off by up to 5 %. Does not work while the car is switched off.
automation.window_preset_description: Moves a window to a preset position: Shut, Slightly open, Half open or Fully open. It can be off by up to 5 %. Does not work while the car is switched off.
automation.set_surveillance_description: Turns the Guardian on or off. If the car is switched on right now, it takes effect the next time the car is switched off.
automation.set_operating_mode_description: Chooses when Panoptes is active. “Only when on” shuts down all Panoptes services in an orderly way after the ignition goes off (ACC off). “On and off” keeps the Guardian and the background watching going while the car is parked.
automation.set_recording_description: Sets the mode of the drive camera. The clip settings explain each mode.
automation.save_replay_description: Saves a short clip from the recent footage of the drive camera. Only works while a recording mode is on (camera running). The two numbers are the seconds before and after the moment. Together they must be between 1 and 60 seconds.
automation.set_drive_mode_description: Switches the drive mode: Normal, ECO, Sport, Snow or Rain.
automation.set_powertrain_mode_description: Switches between electric (EV) and hybrid (HEV) on DM/PHEV cars.
automation.hold_battery_description: Switches to HEV, so the engine drives the car instead of the battery. Plug-in hybrids only. Note: on some trims the engine still charges the battery in HEV. To keep the charge at a fixed level, use “Charge cap” instead.
automation.soc_hold_percent_description: Sets the charge cap, the level where charging stops (50 to 100). Save the level before you switch the charge cap on. It is separate from Battery hold, which is for driving a PHEV.
automation.soc_hold_enabled_description: Turns the charge cap on or off, using the saved level.
automation.ac_charge_current_limit_description: Sets how much current the car takes at its AC charging socket. It only counts as done once the car reports the same value back.
automation.smart_charging_description: Turns the charging plan in the cloud on or off. The saved times stay as they are.
automation.charging_schedule_description: Saves a charging time window in the cloud. Give times as HH:mm. Use full as the end time for no end. For the days, use s, e, or a list of weekdays from 0 to 6 separated by commas, with no repeats.
automation.start_charging_description: Starts charging right away through the cloud.
automation.set_regen_description: Sets how strongly the car brakes with the motor to win back energy.
automation.set_steering_description: Sets the steering assist: Comfort or Sport.
automation.rotate_infotainment_description: Sets the middle screen to landscape or portrait, or flips between the two.
automation.native_camera_view_description: Changes the view in the car maker's own surround camera app. That camera screen has to be open to see the chosen view.
automation.run_shell_description: Runs a command in the background service when this rule fires. It runs on its own and needs the separate rule-shell permission (off by default). You can put in live numbers: ${signal:batteryLevel} for a car value and ${var:NAME} for a variable, for example input tap ${var:tap_x} 400. Only numbers are filled in. If a value is not a number, the command does not run. To do maths first, use the “Calculate into variable” action and refer to its result. Everything else ($HOME, $((1+2)), $(cmd)) is left to the shell as before.
automation.generate_ai_insight_description: Writes a summary based on real data, saves it in the Ask Panoptes inbox and, if you like, sends it as a Panoptes alert. Does nothing while the main switch for Ask Panoptes is off.
automation.pause_description: Waits a set number of milliseconds before the next action runs.
automation.wait_until_description: Pauses the remaining actions until a chosen value passes a comparison. Example: wait until Speed = 0 before closing the windows. If the time limit runs out first, the remaining actions are SKIPPED, because what you waited for never happened.
automation.wait_timeout: Time limit (seconds, 0 = wait as long as it takes)
automation.wait_until_state_description: Pauses the remaining actions until a chosen on/off value reaches a state. Example: wait until Turn signals = Off before going on. If the time limit runs out first, the remaining actions are SKIPPED, because the state never came.
automation.open_app_description: Starts an installed app when this rule fires.
automation.open_app_split_description: Starts an installed app on one half of the screen (split screen) when this rule fires.
automation.open_apps_split_description: Starts two chosen apps together in split screen when this rule fires.
automation.show_camera_view_description: Shows a camera view on the main screen or the driver display, at the position you choose. Pick one camera, all four, or the combined rear + side view for either side. The combined views follow your Blind spot settings for cameras shown, fisheye correction and rotation. It shares the screen with Blind spot, which wins while it is active.
automation.show_camera_feed_description: Shows a camera picture in the saved size and position of the camera view. You choose how long it stays. The blind spot view can take over the shared screen for a while when it is active.
automation.set_camera_view_size_description: Sets the size of the normal camera view for one screen and keeps its saved position. If that view is showing there, it changes size right away. Otherwise the next camera picture uses this size.
automation.set_bs_overlay_size_description: Sets the saved size of the blind spot window for one screen. The view that the turn signal triggers keeps its left and right positions and only shows while a turn signal is on.
automation.show_blind_spot_camera_feed_description: Shows the rear + side camera picture by hand for one side, using the saved blind spot setup. Fisheye correction, cameras shown and rotation stay as they are. For the view that the turn signal triggers, use “Blind spot: on/off” instead.
automation.bs_fisheye_description: Sets how strongly the fisheye (barrel) curve is straightened in the blind spot view. Higher values flatten the bulge but trim the edges a little. Only for the single-camera side and rear views, not for the combined rear + side view.
automation.bs_fisheye_step_description: Raises or lowers the blind spot fisheye correction by one step, so a rule can nudge it instead of jumping to a fixed level. Stops at the limits 0 and 100.
automation.bs_cameras_description: Chooses whether the blind spot view combines the rear and side cameras or shows only one of them. A single camera fills the window with its full field of view.
automation.bs_rotation_description: Turns the blind spot picture on the screen. The left and right cameras are mirror images, so each side can be set on its own. 40° and 310° are ready-made blind spot views that also crop, mirror and zoom by themselves. Auto follows the direction of travel and flips by 180° when reversing. Only for the single-camera side and rear views.
automation.bs_enable_description: Turns the blind spot view on or off. When it is on, a rear + side camera picture shows in a floating window when you use the turn signal.
automation.bs_dismiss_description: Hides the blind spot view that is showing right now, without switching the feature off. It comes back the next time you use the turn signal.
automation.shell_warning: Runs on its own whenever this rule fires. A faulty command can disturb the main screen. Needs the rule-shell permission.
automation.set_ambient_description: Changes the colour of the inside ambient light for the front, the rear or both zones. Does not work while the car is switched off.
automation.set_media_volume_description: Sets the volume for media (music) from 0 to 100 percent.
automation.set_channel_volume_description: Sets the volume of a chosen audio channel (media, navigation, speech, phone and more) from 0 to 100 percent.
automation.set_screen_brightness_description: Sets the brightness of the main screen from 0 to 100 percent. Does not work while the car is switched off.
automation.set_cluster_brightness_description: Sets the brightness of the driver display behind the steering wheel from 0 to 100 percent. Does not work while the car is switched off.
automation.set_hud_brightness_description: Sets the brightness of the head-up display from 0 to 100 percent. 0 dims it completely, because there is no separate on/off for the HUD. Does not work while the car is switched off.
automation.set_hud_power_description: Turns the head-up display on or off. If a car has no HUD switch of its own, Off sets the brightness to 0 and On brings back full brightness. Does not work while the car is switched off.
automation.set_screen_power_description: Switches the middle screen on or off. It goes fully dark while the system stays awake, so recording and background functions keep running. Switching it on again brings the picture back.
automation.set_lane_assist_description: Sets the lane assist mode: Off, Lane warning (only warns), Lane keeping (steers you back) or both. Does not work while the car is switched off.
automation.set_brake_feel_description: Sets how the brake pedal feels: Comfort or Sport/Strong.
automation.play_audio_description: Plays one of your uploaded sounds (MP3/WAV) through the speakers of the car, on a channel you choose. Upload sounds in the audio library on the Rules page.
automation.play_video_description: Plays one of your uploaded videos (MP4) with the picture on the main screen and the sound on the Media channel. Upload videos in the audio library on the Rules page.
automation.stop_audio_description: Stops any sound or video that a “Play a sound” or “Play a video” action started.
automation.speed_description: The car's speed right now, in the unit you choose.
automation.accelerator_description: How far the gas pedal is pressed, from 0 to 100 percent.
automation.brake_description: How far the brake pedal is pressed, from 0 to 100 percent.
automation.steering_angle_description: The angle of the steering wheel in degrees. Negative is left, positive is right, 0 is straight ahead.
automation.turn_signal_description: Whether a turn signal is on. Pick the side (left or right). The blinking is smoothed out, so a flashing signal counts as steadily on.
automation.blind_spot_description: Whether the radar warning for the blind spot or a lane change is warning on one side. Rear cross traffic and door opening warnings are separate values for rules. Warnings are short, so the value stays on for a few seconds after the last one.
automation.rear_cross_traffic_description: Whether the rear cross traffic warning is warning on one side while reversing. Warnings are short, so the value stays on for a few seconds after the last one.
automation.door_open_warning_description: Whether the door opening warning is warning on one side because traffic is coming. Warnings are short, so the value stays on for a few seconds after the last one.
automation.time_description: The local time of your car. Comparisons treat midnight as the lowest time and 23:59 as the highest.
automation.wifi_state_description: Whether the car is connected to a Wi-Fi network.
automation.wifi_ssid_description: The name (SSID) of the Wi-Fi network you are connected to. Empty when there is no Wi-Fi connection.
automation.bt_state_description: Whether a Bluetooth device (a phone) is connected to the car.
automation.bt_device_name_description: The name of the Bluetooth device that is connected right now. Empty if there is none.
automation.location_zone_description: The name of the zone the car is in right now (set up under Quiet zones), or "none" if it is outside every zone. Fires when the car enters or leaves a zone. You set up zones on the map, with a radius down to 15 m, on the Guardian page.
automation.emergency_alarm_description: An old value that is no longer supported. The car reports its anti-theft state here (armed or not), not a crash or an emergency.
automation.tyre_pressure_warn_description: The worst tyre pressure state across all four wheels: normal, too low or too high. Fires when the pressure warning of any wheel changes.
automation.tyre_leak_warn_description: The worst tyre leak state across all four wheels: normal, slow leak or fast leak. Fires when the leak warning of any wheel changes.
automation.surveillance_armed_description: Fires when the parked Guardian wakes up or goes to sleep. Use it to make a rule depend on the car being watched, for example only while the Guardian is awake.
automation.surveillance_threat_description: The threat level of the latest recorded Guardian event: notice, warning or critical. Fires once per event, when the clip is saved.
automation.surveillance_object_description: The main thing seen in the latest Guardian event: person, vehicle, bike, animal or nothing.
automation.charging_state_description: Fires when the car starts or stops charging. This is the combined charging state, the same one the app shows.
automation.charge_gun_description: Fires when the charging cable is plugged in or pulled out. A car that is plugged in may not be charging yet, for example because of a charging plan.
automation.battery_soh_description: How healthy the high-voltage battery is, in percent.
automation.key_battery_description: The battery state of the smart key fob. Fires when it reports low or normal.
automation.aux_12v_voltage_description: The voltage of the 12 V starter battery in TENTHS of a volt (135 = 13.5 V). Use it for a limit like “below 122” (12.2 V), to catch a draining battery before the car won't start.
automation.aux_12v_battery_description: The state of the 12 V starter battery. Fires when it reports low or normal.
automation.fuel_level_description: How full the fuel tank is, in percent (PHEV only).
automation.pm25_description: The amount of fine dust (PM2.5) inside or outside the car, in µg/m³. Choose inside or outside.
automation.slope_description: The slope of the road in degrees (negative = downhill, positive = uphill).
automation.radar_nearest_description: The distance to the closest obstacle that any parking sensor sees, in centimetres. Only active at low speed with the radar switched on.
automation.seatbelt_description: Fires when a seat belt is fastened or unfastened. Pick the driver seat or the front passenger seat.
automation.auto_wiper_description: Fires when the automatic rain-sensing wiper mode is switched on or off. It does not tell you whether it is raining or whether the wipers are moving.
automation.wiper_active_description: Fires when the windscreen wipers start or stop, at any speed.
automation.auto_lights_description: Fires when the automatic headlight mode is switched on or off. It does not tell you whether it is dark or whether the lights are on right now.
automation.occupant_description: Fires when a seat becomes occupied or empty. The passenger seat uses its occupancy sensor if there is one. If the car has none, it guesses from the passenger belt reminder and a fastened belt: a warning or a fastened belt means Taken, otherwise Empty. The guess can be wrong if an empty seat has a fastened belt or the reminder is muted. The driver seat has no sensor, so it only ever reports Taken, once per drive, and never Empty. To react to belts being fastened or unfastened, use the Seat belt trigger instead.
automation.boot_description: Fires once, shortly after the car's system has started up.
automation.set_variable_description: Gives a named variable (a marker) a value. Use it to make rules work together. For example, set a marker at the start of a routine and check it in the condition, so the routine does not start again while it is still running. Or share a mode between several rules.
automation.variable_description: Checks a named variable that you set with the “Set a variable” action. Compare it with a value (equal or not equal), for example Parking_Mode not equal to true. A variable that was never set counts as empty, so “not equal to true” is true until you set it.
automation.door_state_description: Fires when a door, the bonnet, the boot or the fuel cap opens or closes. Pick which one (or any), and whether it opened or closed.
automation.day_description: Which day of the week it is.
automation.set_bsd_description: Turns blind spot detection on or off. Check that your model supports it.
automation.set_tsr_description: Turns traffic sign recognition on or off.
automation.set_rcta_description: Turns the rear cross traffic warning on or off.
automation.set_fcta_description: Turns the front cross traffic warning on or off.
automation.set_tla_description: Turns the traffic light reminder on or off.
automation.set_dow_description: Turns the door opening warning on or off.
automation.set_rcw_description: Turns the rear collision warning on or off.
automation.set_islc_description: Turns intelligent speed limit control on or off.
automation.set_elka_description: SAFETY: Emergency lane keeping steers the car back into its lane in an emergency. Switching it OFF removes that help.
automation.set_rctb_description: SAFETY: brakes by itself for cross traffic behind the car. Switching it OFF means less protection.
automation.set_fctb_description: SAFETY: brakes by itself for cross traffic in front of the car. Switching it OFF means less protection.
automation.set_fcw_description: SAFETY: sets how sensitive the forward collision warning is. A lower level warns later.
automation.set_aeb_description: SAFETY-CRITICAL: switches automatic emergency braking (AEB) back on. For safety, this action can only switch it ON, never off.
automation.rain_probability_description: The forecast chance of rain (%) for the next few hours, from local weather by GPS. Needs a position fix and a network connection.
automation.speak_description: Reads a message out loud (text to speech), for example “Charging complete”. The text can contain ${var:NAME} or ${signal:TYPE} placeholders, which are replaced with the live value when it fires.
automation.show_toast_description: Shows a short message that floats over the current app and fades out by itself. It does not interrupt what is playing or take over the screen. The message can contain ${var:NAME} or ${signal:TYPE} placeholders, which are replaced with the live value when it fires.
automation.show_dialog_description: Shows a box on screen with a title, a message and an OK button. It floats over the current app without taking focus and closes when someone taps OK, or after the optional time limit. Title and message can contain ${var:NAME} or ${signal:TYPE} placeholders, which are replaced with the live value when it fires.
automation.ui_nav_description: Presses a system navigation button: Home screen, Back or Recent apps.
automation.screenshot_description: Saves a screenshot of the chosen screen to storage.
automation.ivi_reboot_description: Restarts the Android system of the car. It only runs while parked, and it is blocked for the first five minutes after startup or after another restart request, so it cannot get stuck in a loop.
automation.move_app_display_description: Moves an app to the main screen or to the driver display.
automation.stop_cluster_cast_description: Stops casting an app to the driver display and brings the normal gauges back.
automation.call_state_description: The state of the phone call: ringing (incoming or outgoing), active or idle. Needs the phone permission.
automation.increment_variable_description: Adds a number to a number variable, or subtracts it if you use a negative amount. Handy for a counter.
automation.compute_variable_description: Works out a number and stores it in a variable. Supports + - * / % , brackets and the functions min, max, clamp, round, floor, ceil, abs, sqrt and pow. Use ${signal:NAME} for a live car value and ${var:NAME} for another variable, for example 500 + (${signal:batteryLevel} - 20) * 3.75. If a value can't be read (for example a value that has not reported yet), the variable stays as it was.
automation.capture_variable_description: Saves the current media volume or the EV battery charge level as a named variable. The number is a snapshot that later actions can use, for example to restore the media volume.
automation.loop_description: Repeats the actions inside it a set number of times, or while or until a value condition holds.
automation.if_description: Runs the “then” actions inside it when a condition holds, otherwise the “else” actions.
automation.action_group_run_description: Runs a saved action group by its name. A group can be reused in many rules.
automation.control_automation_description: Switches another rule on or off, or toggles it. This way a rule can arm or disarm a routine.
automation.radio_description: Turns a radio of the device on or off. Turning Wi-Fi off also stops the keep-alive from turning it back on, until you switch it on again.
automation.mqtt_publish_description: Sends a message to your MQTT broker, for example to tell Home Assistant. It goes to every connection you have set up. Topic and payload can contain ${var:NAME} or ${signal:TYPE} placeholders, which are replaced with the live value when it fires.
automation.mqtt_trigger_description: Fires when your MQTT broker publishes to <base>/rule/<channel>, for example from Home Assistant. Enter the channel name and the value to match.
automation.battery_hold_description: Holds the battery charge with the car's own charge-hold feature. “Use charge target” switches on the separately set charge target without replacing it. “Keep current level” uses the current charge, capped at 50 %. “Run down to minimum” uses the car's reserve. (PHEV only.)
automation.wireless_charging_left_description: Switches the left phone charging pad on or off. Only for cars with two pads.
automation.wireless_charging_right_description: Switches the right phone charging pad on or off. Only for cars with two pads.
automation.apply_seat_position_description: Moves the driver seat and both side mirrors to a position saved in Panoptes. You can save a position by holding a memory button in the car, or on the Seats page. The car must be switched on.
automation.wallbox_mode_description: Starts or stops charging at the released wallbox (only when parked).
automation.wallbox_current_description: Sets the charging current of the released wallbox (only when parked).
automation.set_camping_description: Turns camping mode on or off.
automation.charge_plan_description: Charge now, stop charging now, or resume the plan.

messages.soh_reset_complete: Battery health estimate was reset and starts fresh.
messages.quality_storage_settings_updated_cleanup: Storage settings saved. To stay within the new limit, the oldest files will be deleted.
messages.quality_h265_note: H.265 makes files about half the size. Restart the recording so the new format takes effect.
messages.update_queued: Update is next in line — download starts soon…
messages.update_installing_finishing: Installing now. The car screen will be back in a moment.

triggerMode.title: When should the Guardian record?
triggerMode.help: Your choice. Without a choice the previous behaviour applies (AI detection everywhere).

privateZones.title: Private places
privateZones.help: Places (centre and radius) where AI detection may record, e.g. garage or driveway.

clipRetentionHours.title: Keep clips for
clipRetentionHours.help: Off = unlimited (storage space only). Recommended: 72 h. Guardian, drive and approach clips are deleted automatically after this time unless you keep them.

keepDays.title: “Keep” lasts
keepDays.help: How long a kept clip (damage/crash) stays. After that Panoptes asks you; nothing is deleted without asking.

deterrentQuietSeconds.title: Quiet time after the warn-off
deterrentQuietSeconds.help: After a warn-off the display stays off this long, even if movement continues. A warn-off lasts at most 30 s.

shockSensitivity.title: Detect bumps
shockSensitivity.help: Records when someone bumps or touches the parked car (acceleration sensor, frugal: 25 readings per second, only while the Guardian is armed).

display.title: Notice on the screen
display.help: Shows on the display that the vehicle is protected.

light.title: Lights on approach
light.help: Flashes the lights briefly. Via the BYD cloud only while the car is off.

horn.title: Horn on approach
horn.help: "Find car" (horn and lights). Exceptional cases only, never a default.

enabled.title: Guardian stop enabled
enabled.help: Saves the battery: the Guardian stops under the conditions below.

v12Below.title: 12 V battery below
v12Below.help: 0 = off. Default by battery type (LFP 12.8 V, lead-acid 12.2 V).

v12Resume.title: Resume from
v12Resume.help: Voltage at which the Guardian starts again.

maxParkHours.title: After parking this many hours
maxParkHours.help: 0 = off. Applies until the next drive.

windows.title: Off at these times
windows.help: For example at night in your own garage.

reenable.title: Resume automatically
reenable.help: When charge or 12 V battery recover.

notify.title: Notify
notify.help: Message with reason when the Guardian stops or resumes.

akkuChemie.title: 12 V battery type
akkuChemie.help: Sets the default thresholds. "Automatic" uses the vehicle model entry or detects LFP from the resting voltage (≥ 13.0 V after 1 h parked on 3 days), otherwise lead-acid is assumed.

autoId.title: Car ID
autoId.help: Fixed random ID of this installation for the planner. Never the VIN.

memberToken.title: Member key
memberToken.help: Key of the BYD community membership (planner, community).

band.title: “Will it make it?” on screen
band.help: While driving with a planner route, briefly shows top right whether the battery reaches the next charging stop (8 s on every change and every 10 min). No buttons.

ansage.title: Announce “Will it make it?”
ansage.help: Reads the first line aloud on every change (at most every 10 min). Off by default.

zustandSenden.title: Send status to route planner
zustandSenden.help: Sends charge level, range and whether the car is charging to the route planner – never the position.

positionSenden.title: Send position for route start
positionSenden.help: Sends the car’s last location as the starting point to the charge planner – only together with “Send status”.

unterwegs.title: On-the-road help
unterwegs.help: While you drive, Panoptes fetches your planned route from the route planner every minute and shows whether the battery reaches the next stop. This sends the device key to byd.serveone.at; your position only if it gets tight and a new charging stop is searched. Needs the route planner connection. Off by default.

abweichung.title: Re-plan on the road
abweichung.help: While driving a route you accepted, checks whether you are still on plan: every 10 minutes (or every 5 % battery) the route, your position (rounded to about 100 m) and the battery level go to the route planner at byd.serveone.at, which stores none of it. If you are clearly off plan, Panoptes suggests a new charging stop – never automatically into the navigation. Needs the on-the-road help. Off by default.

vorliebenSenden.title: Send charging preferences to the route planner
vorliebenSenden.help: So /ev/ in the browser knows your charging cards and networks from the car – only together with “Send status”.

enabled.title: Community: share rules and road conditions
enabled.help: Connects to the Panoptes community server (byd.serveone.at). Needs the member key. Off = no calls at all. Road reports are only sent if you also turn them on under road conditions.

enabled.title: Speed camera warning
enabled.help: Short on-screen notice before fixed speed cameras ahead. Austria only; automatically off in all other countries.

ansage.title: Announce speed cameras
ansage.help: Also reads the notice aloud. Off by default.

ton.title: Sound for speed camera notes
ton.help: Off: only the note on screen. Alert tone: a short tone on the navigation channel (music gets quieter briefly). Spoken: the note is read out. Like the speed camera note itself, only in Austria.

kanal.title: Update channel
kanal.help: Stable = tested versions. Test = also pre-releases for trying out.

modus.title: Install updates
modus.help: “Notify only” shows new versions and you install them yourself. “Automatic” installs once the car has been off for at least 10 minutes. Never while driving; if something goes wrong, the previous version comes back by itself within 30 minutes.

pruefen.title: Check for updates
pruefen.help: Every 6 hours Panoptes asks GitHub whether a new version exists. GitHub sees the car's IP address and the time; nothing else is sent. Off = no background check; you can still search yourself at any time.

mobilfunk.title: Download updates over mobile data too
mobilfunk.help: Many cars are only online through their built-in SIM, so this is on. An update is usually 70 to 120 MB; the size is shown in the notice beforehand. Off = Panoptes only downloads while the car is on Wi-Fi. The download only runs while the car is parked and resumes where it stopped after an interruption.

quelle.title: Update source
quelle.help: Public = the official Panoptes versions on GitHub, no sign-in. Own = another GitHub repo, e.g. your own build; for a private repo with a read token. Every version is checked for checksum and signature before installing, wherever it comes from.

repo.title: Repo for updates
repo.help: GitHub repo in the form owner/name. Only with “Own repo”.

token.title: Read token for the repo
token.help: Only needed for a private repo: a GitHub token that may only read this repo. It is only sent to GitHub and never shown.

positionTeilen.title: Home Assistant: share location
positionTeilen.help: Lets Home Assistant read the car's location (it must also be switched on in Home Assistant). Off by default.

mdns.title: Home Assistant: announce on Wi-Fi
mdns.help: Panoptes announces itself on the same Wi-Fi so Home Assistant finds it without an address. Takes effect after a restart. Off by default.

planer.title: View logbook in the route planner
planer.help: Lets you view your logbook on byd.serveone.at/ev/. It stays in the car: Panoptes sends each page encrypted only, the server can't read it and stores nothing. For this Panoptes checks with the route planner once a minute (a few KB). Needs the route planner connection. Off by default.

waerme.title: Warmth
waerme.help: How warm it should get at night. Without a cabin sensor Panoptes heats in intervals based on the outside temperature (every x minutes for y minutes). "Save" uses only the seat heating. "Heating method" sets how it heats.

heizweg.title: Heating method
heizweg.help: How Panoptes heats. "Only when the car is on" switches the climate locally while the car is on in P. "Also via the BYD cloud" starts remote climate sessions when the car is off (10–30 min, at most 12 per night, at least 45 min apart); this wakes the car each time. "Trial run" switches nothing and only shows what would happen. Each cloud session only counts with a confirmation from BYD; after two failures cloud heating rests until the next camping.
heizweg.auto_an: Only when the car is on (local)
heizweg.auto_an_und_cloud: Also via the BYD cloud when the car is off

vorheizenMinuten.title: Preheat before sleeping
vorheizenMinuten.help: Heat strongly once when camping starts, for this many minutes. 0 = off.

morgensHeizen.title: Heat in the morning
morgensHeizen.help: Heat before the wake-up time. The energy for it is set aside in the budget first.

weckzeit.title: Wake-up time
weckzeit.help: The heating should last until then. If the battery is not enough, Panoptes lengthens the pauses automatically.

socGrenze.title: Battery lower limit
socGrenze.help: Heating stops here; a warning comes first. Panoptes never switches the car off.

v12Warnung.title: 12 V warning
v12Warnung.help: If the starter battery drops below this, heating stops and you get a message. Empty = off.

nachlaufMinuten.title: Run-on after wake-up
nachlaufMinuten.help: Camping ends this many minutes after the wake-up time – unless the plan has its own end. At the latest after the maximum time, immediately when you drive off.

hoechstdauerStunden.title: Maximum duration
hoechstdauerStunden.help: Camping (and with it the heating) ends after this many hours at the latest, with a message.

waechterBewohnt.title: Guardian "occupied"
waechterBewohnt.help: While camping: no deterrent (screen, lights, horn) and no shock alarm. Doors and windows are reported quietly.

aussenBewegung.title: Movement outside
aussenBewegung.help: What the guardian does about movement around the car while camping.

nachtNachSekunden.title: Night screen after
nachtNachSekunden.help: Without a touch the screen turns into the dark night screen after this many seconds.

profil.title: Energy while parked
profil.help: How much Panoptes protects the starter battery while parked. Normal = as before. Economy: keep-screen-awake only while the guardian is on, GPS every 10 s while parked, guardian camera throttled when idle (full rate on motion). Minimal: additionally no keep-screen-awake, GPS every 30 s, stronger throttling. Values you set yourself still apply.

gpsStandSekunden.title: GPS while parked every … seconds
gpsStandSekunden.help: How often Panoptes passes on the last position while parked. Always every second while driving. Empty = from profile.

weckMinuten.title: Self-healing every … minutes
weckMinuten.help: How often Android wakes Panoptes if all its parts were stopped at once. At most 10 minutes, otherwise the car cuts the connection. Empty = from profile.

online.title: Weather from the internet (Open-Meteo)
online.help: If the car does not report an outside temperature or a rule uses “rain likely”, Panoptes asks Open-Meteo. The approximate location (rounded to about 1 km) is sent to Open-Meteo at most every 10 minutes. Panoptes stores nothing there; switching off stops the requests immediately. Off by default.

quelle.help: Where Panoptes loads map images from. The chosen source sees your IP address and the map area, so roughly where your car is. “None”: no maps are loaded. Factory default: None. Panoptes never switches to another source by itself.

parkingMessages.title: Parking message in Telegram
parkingMessages.help: After parking, sends a Telegram message with the car’s position. Off for new setups; existing setups keep their previous setting.

zurueckAmAuto.title: “Back at the car” message
zurueckAmAuto.help: When the ignition is switched on after at least 10 minutes parked, sends a short Telegram message with parking time and number of events. Default: off.

version.title: Disclaimer confirmed (version)
version.help: Version of the disclaimer you last confirmed. When there is a new version, Panoptes asks again.

darstellung.title: Display in the car
darstellung.help: Light spares the car screen: maps in 2D, no blur effects or continuous animations. Full shows everything but costs noticeable performance on the car screen.

bandGroesse.title: Size of on-screen notes
bandGroesse.help: Applies to speed camera notes and “Will it reach?”. Large is easy to read through CarPlay or Android Auto too.

bandPosition.title: Position of notes
bandPosition.help: Where the note appears at the top of the screen.

fpsRuhe.title: Camera when parked without motion
fpsRuhe.help: Frames per second while the Guardian is on and nothing moves. Fewer frames = less power and processor load; how much depends on the car and is not measured per model. When parked, motion detection only checks every third frame of the motion rate anyway; if the idle rate is lower than that, Panoptes raises it just enough to keep detection equally good. On motion the camera switches to the motion rate right away. Empty = from the energy profile.

fpsBewegung.title: Camera when parked with motion
fpsBewegung.help: Frames per second as soon as something moves or is recorded. More frames = smoother recordings but more power. 10 or 15 recommended; below 5, fast movement looks jerky in the recording. Empty = as before (usually 15).

fps.gesperrtHal: This car's camera does not deliver this rate.

weg.title: Autostart permission
weg.help: How Panoptes restores the autostart permission after an update. Visible: via the BYD page on the screen. Settings: in the background, without anything on screen (only once confirmed for your car).

beiZuendung.title: Open Panoptes when the ignition is switched on
beiZuendung.help: Every time you switch the car on, Panoptes comes to the front. If CarPlay or Android Auto is running, that stays in front. Display only – no sound. Off by default.

ueberCarPlay.title: Panoptes notes visible over CarPlay?
ueberCarPlay.help: Do you see Panoptes notes (e.g. the speed camera banner) while CarPlay is running? Your answer applies to your car and takes priority over the community list. Unknown: notes over CarPlay stay off.

ueberAndroidAuto.title: Panoptes notes visible over Android Auto?
ueberAndroidAuto.help: Do you see Panoptes notes (e.g. the speed camera banner) while Android Auto is running? Your answer applies to your car and takes priority over the community list. Unknown: notes over Android Auto stay off.

karten.title: My charging cards
karten.help: Cards and tariffs you own. The route planner uses them for prices (prices always come fresh from the planner).

nurMeineKarten.title: Only chargers with my cards
nurMeineKarten.help: Plans only stops where one of your cards has a known price – unless the destination could not be reached otherwise.

netze.title: Preferred charging networks
netze.help: Operators you like to charge with. Any operator can be chosen.

netzeModus.title: Charging networks
netzeModus.help: Prefer: a detour up to the limit is fine. Only: just these networks, if one is reachable.

umwegMaxMin.title: Detour for preferred networks
umwegMaxMin.help: How many minutes of detour are fine for a preferred network.

nurOffen.title: Only open chargers
nurOffen.help: Chargers listed as closed at your arrival are left out. Unknown opening hours count as open.

meiden.title: Avoid operators
meiden.help: The route planner never plans a stop with these operators.

minKw.title: Minimum charging power
minKw.help: Slower chargers are not used as stops. Empty = planner default.

stecker.title: Plugs
stecker.help: Which plugs your car can use. Empty = planner default (CCS and Type 2).

ankunftSocMin.title: Arrive with at least
ankunftSocMin.help: Charge level on arrival at the destination and at every stop. Also used by “Will it make it?”. Empty = planner default.

ladenBis.title: Charge up to
ladenBis.help: Charge level to charge to at a stop. Empty = planner default.

modus.title: Planning
modus.help: What the route planner looks for when picking chargers. Empty = planner default.

fahrzeug.title: Vehicle model for the route planner
fahrzeug.help: Which model and variant you drive. Panoptes only chooses by itself if it is unambiguous – otherwise please pick it once.

nachfragen.title: Ask after charging
nachfragen.help: After each charge at an unknown place, Panoptes asks while parked: “Where did you charge?” – with card and price. Never while driving, no sound.

acStandard.title: AC charging at unknown places costs
acStandard.help: Applies to all AC charges at places you have not saved (e.g. at home), so Panoptes does not ask there. 0 = free. Empty = ask every time.

an.title: Count anonymously
an.help: Once a day Panoptes reports only a random ID and the version number, no data about you or your car. Off by default. Switching it off also deletes the count on the server.

kennung.title: Random ID
kennung.help: Created only here and has nothing to do with you, the car or the device. Empty while counting is off.

kennungAktion.title: Change ID
kennungAktion.help: Create a new one or delete it. The old ID is also deleted on the server. Deleting switches counting off.

url.title: Count address
url.help: Where the count is sent. Only change it if you run your own counter.

teilen.title: Share charging curve anonymously
teilen.help: While DC charging, Panoptes measures how many kW the car takes at which charge level and keeps it in the car. When on, at most once a day a summary per model goes to the route planner: charge-level bands, typical kW, number of charges. No location, no time, no VIN, not linked to your account. Off by default. Turning it off also deletes it on the server.

kennung.title: Random ID (charging curve)
kennung.help: Only for sharing the charging curve, created here, not linked to you, the car or the device. It lets the server replace your car's curve instead of counting it twice. Empty while sharing is off.

url.title: Charging curve address
url.help: Where the charging curve is sent. Only change this if you run your own route planner.

an.title: Remember habits
an.help: Panoptes remembers, only here in the car, what you often do the same way (e.g. preheating every morning) and can later offer to do it for you. Nothing is sent to a server.

aufbewahrungTage.title: Keep habits for
aufbewahrungTage.help: Number of days the remembered actions stay in the car before they are deleted.

vergessen.title: Forget habits
vergessen.help: Deletes everything remembered and all declined suggestions. Automations already created stay.

rechtshinweis.title: Speed camera display: please read first
rechtshinweis.text: Panoptes can show known speed cameras on the map (data from OpenStreetMap). In Germany (§ 23 (1c) StVO), Switzerland, France and other countries it is forbidden to use a device that shows or warns about speed cameras while driving. Only turn the display on where this is allowed. You are responsible for that yourself. The same applies to sounds and voice announcements: an audible warning is forbidden there too. Panoptes only gives a warning while driving in Austria. Not legal advice, as of 10/2026. The law may change; check the rules of your country.

zustandEinwilligung.title: Send status to the route planner?
zustandEinwilligung.text: What: charge level, range as shown by the car, whether and at how many kW it is charging, time. No position, no VIN. Where: byd.serveone.at (route planner), only into your account. Only the latest value is stored, no history. Why: starting charge level when planning. Switching off also deletes the data on the server.

positionEinwilligung.title: Send position for the route start?
positionEinwilligung.text: What: the car’s current location, only the latest, no history. Where: byd.serveone.at (charge planner), only into your account. How long: at most 15 minutes, in memory only, not stored, not logged. Why: starting point when planning a route. Switching off deletes it on the server immediately.

navi.anfrage_gross: Request is empty or too large
navi.zu_viele: Too many requests – please wait 2 minutes.
navi.antwortet_nicht: The route planner is not answering (HTTP {0}). For long routes, please try again.
navi.offline: Route planner not reachable right now (no connection) – next try in {0} s
navi.fahrzeug_fehlt: Please choose your vehicle model first (Charging → Vehicle model) so the route planner uses the right values.
navi.planer_fehler: The route planner could not plan this route ({0}).
navi.planer_fehler_allgemein: The route planner could not plan this route.

vorliebenEinwilligung.title: Send charging preferences to the route planner?
vorliebenEinwilligung.text: What: your charging cards (only which ones, no charging sessions), preferred and avoided networks, detour, “only open”, minimum power, plugs, arrival charge level, “charge up to”, planning mode. No position. Where: byd.serveone.at (charging planner), only into your account. How long: up to 24 hours in memory, never on disk, not logged. What for: /ev/ in the browser plans with the preferences from your car. Switching off deletes them on the server right away.

ladekurveEinwilligung.title: Share charging curve anonymously?
ladekurveEinwilligung.text: What: for each charge-level band (5 %), the typical DC charging power of your model and how many charges it is based on. No location, no time of day, no date, no VIN, no individual charges, no account. Where: byd.serveone.at (route planner), with a random ID used only for this. Why: realistic charging times for everyone with the same model. Turning it off also deletes your curve on the server.

routine.invalid_decision: Allowed are: save, later, dismiss or reset.
routine.suggestion_unavailable: This suggestion is no longer available.
routine.decision_failed: The decision could not be applied.
routine.routine_persist_failed: The decision could not be saved.
routine.invalid_automation: No valid rule could be built from the suggestion.
routine.automation_persist_failed: The rule could not be saved.

genai.automation_created_manual: Created and saved to run by hand only. Check it before you let it run automatically.

uebernahme.manuell: Not taken over (permission or safety). Please choose it yourself in Panoptes.
uebernahme.neuEingeben: Credentials are never taken over. Please enter them again in Panoptes.
uebernahme.mqttAus: Comes switched off, without control and without user/password. Please check and switch it on yourself.
uebernahme.preisPruefen: This price looks implausible or the currency is missing. It is not taken over – please enter it yourself under Charging.

fehler.name: Please enter a name (at most 64 characters).
fehler.koordinaten: The place has no valid position.
fehler.radius: The radius is outside the allowed range.
fehler.radius_eigenschaft: The radius is too small or too large for this property.
fehler.nicht_gefunden: This place does not exist (any more).
fehler.ruhezonen_voll: At most 10 quiet zones or home places are possible.
fehler.eigenschaft: A property has an invalid value.
fehler.tarif_nicht_angelegt: The tariff could not be created.

fehler.key: The auth key is invalid (it starts with "tskey-").
fehler.name: The device name may only contain lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
fehler.weg1_fehlt: The regular remote access is not running right now. The emergency access can only be set up safely while it runs.
fehler.nicht_eingerichtet: The emergency access has not been set up yet.
fehler.startet_nicht: The emergency access does not start. Please try again later.
fehler.anmeldung: Signing in to the tailnet failed. Please check the auth key.
fehler.installieren: The files for the emergency access could not be created.
fehler.adb_serve: The emergency access is signed in, but the adb forwarding (port 5555) is still missing. The emergency access keeps retrying by itself.
